> **Figure 2.** A tool-free accessibility triage agent classifies hard-to-categorize surface proteins more accurately than any single database. Classification accuracy on SurfaceBench, 147 proteins enriched for disagreement among the five source databases and manually labeled as surface, contextually surface, or non-surface. Bars compare the triage agent (Sonnet 4.6, no external tools) against the five source databases; contextually surface proteins are counted as correct when called surface. Sonnet 4.6 run with 3 replicates. Error bars indicate SEM.
<!-- END manuscript-legend -->

5 surface DBs (UniProt, GO CC, HPA, SURFY, CSPA) + Sonnet 4.6 (+ IDs,
no tools), grouped bars showing accuracy per ground-truth class
(overall / yes / contextual / no). A contextual protein counts as
correct when the caller says surface. The Sonnet bar is the mean
accuracy over its 3 replicates (dots = individual replicates, error
bar = SEM); the DB bars are single deterministic calls. DB cutoffs
are the **trade-off-audit optimized** versions, not canonical
baselines:

* **UniProt — TM+signal**: admit any accession with a TM domain, a
  signal peptide, OR a strict surface subcellular term (looser than
  canonical; rescues more bench positives, at the cost of one extra
  no-class false positive).
* **CSPA — HC-only**: admit only the high-confidence flag (drops
  `putative` + `unspecific`; stricter than canonical, lifts
  accuracy on the no-class).
* **GO CC / HPA / SURFY**: canonical baselines (audit didn't surface
  a better cutoff).

See the companion `db_cutoff_tradeoff` figure for the audit that
recommends these cutoffs.

Run:

```
uv run make_db_correctness_by_class.py
```

Data: the script reads only `db_correctness_by_class.tsv`, bundled
with this gist (it looks next to the script first, then at the
in-repo path
[`data/processed/figures/db_correctness_by_class.tsv`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/data/processed/figures/db_correctness_by_class.tsv);
it downloads nothing). One row per gene × model × prompt variant ×
replicate, with the ground-truth verdict, the five per-DB surface
flags, `uniprot_optimized` + `cspa_optimized`, `predicted_verdict`
and `is_match`. The figure uses the `claude-sonnet-4-6` /
`prompt_variant = ncbi` rows (identifiers only, no tools); the other
model and prompt-variant rows are not plotted. The TSV is built by
[`scripts/build_figure_tsvs.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/build_figure_tsvs.py).
